title: RealFeel this afternoon — *heat*, not rain, is today's story
sub:
High 86°F · low 76°F · UV 5 · light east wind, 6 mph, gusts to 13
A 60% chance of rain and about an hour of it. AccuWeather expects morning showers; two other models put the best chance nearer 3 PM. Grey and very humid until mid-morning, then hot.
The sea is flat — about 2 feet, water 84°F. Beach and pool are the day. Run errands before noon or after 5.

title: The registration deadline for phone numbers *ending in 7*
sub:
Mexico is switching off unregistered mobile lines by last digit. Ending 8: Dec 15. Ending 9: Dec 31. Ending 0 to 6: your date has already passed — but you can still register, free, and get the number back.
Foreign residents: a valid passport is enough. You do not need a CURP.
Start at registratulinea.crt.gob.mx, which sends you to your own carrier. Prepaid and plan lines both count.
source: Diario Oficial de la Federación · CRT

title: More visitors on the Quinta, *the same empty tills*
sub:
Two separate reporting trips found the same thing — foot traffic on Fifth Avenue is up since late October and spending is not. The sellers blame thinner flights from the US; Por Esto's reporting blames all-inclusive packages that keep the money inside the resorts.
The state tourism office puts Playa del Carmen at 69.63% hotel occupancy for January to August, down 4.25 points on 2025.
Own a shop on the Quinta? The city's Navidad Mágica decoration contest takes entries to 30 Nov — 100,000 pesos top prize.

title: A free resident permit that *skips the parking meters*
sub:
If your home in a metered area has no garage — or one that isn't assigned to it — the city issues a tarjetón that exempts you from paying. Valid one year, renewed with a single form.
Bring five things: the application form (original and copy), and copies of your official ID, tarjeta de circulación, proof of address under 60 days old, and a no-debt tenencia certificate.
In person only, 2nd floor of the Palacio Municipal on Av. CTM. Mon to Fri, 9 to 2.

title: Things to do in Playa *next Saturday*
sub:

12 PM — Olimpia Coral Melo on the Ley Olimpia, Teatro de la Ciudad. Free, walk in.

source: El Cine Club · Teatro de la Ciudad · City hall
